subject: Re: Mechanic kickoff — staffing plan
body:
Ximena,

Staffing and compute for Mechanic:

- Rafael 40% (TL, A/B design), Quentin 50% on the workload harness, Efe 25% on theory questions as they come up, Wanjiru 40% on the training-stack flag plumbing.
- Paloma Castillo is the integration lead and is committed at 60%+ to this project for May 2026 — the rollout month is where the platform-side work concentrates, and I've locked that in the May allocation sheet so nothing else grabs her.

Compute: A/B runs fit titan-a100 best-effort — 48 GPUs peak for the March comparisons. No reservation needed; the whole point of this project is to reduce sweep compute, so it'd be embarrassing to over-ask.

One dependency: Wanjiru needs the training-stack release branch to cut on 02-20 as scheduled, otherwise the flag slips a sprint.

Santiago
